entries.028d4bdb6955424e: A manufacturer founded in 1899 that produces and sells fluid machinery such as vacuum pumps, blowers and compressors, and also leases rental buildings.
entries.08c8aa96ced65713: This business manufactures and sells fluid machinery, including vacuum pumps, blowers, compressors and conveying equipment. It purchases raw materials and other inputs, carries out processing, assembly and inspection at its head office and Tamagawa Plant in Ota-ku, Tokyo, and sells directly to customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,279 million, a decrease of 0.6% from the previous year.
